item.title: Rolling Mill Hill/Iron Triangle Residents’ Association to meet Feb. 25
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — Rolling Mill Hill/Iron Triangle Residents’ Association will hold its monthly meeting at 7 p.m. Wednesday, Feb. 25, at the Heritage Point Apartments Community Building, 151 Dana St.

item.title: Bear Creek Twp. is not increasing real estate taxes in 2026
item.description: Bear Creek Township is not increasing its real estate taxes in 2026 as originally reported by the Luzerne County Treasurer’s Office.

item.title: PUC to investigate UGI’s natural gas rate increase request
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — The Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission (PUC) on Thursday voted 5-0 to suspend and investigate a proposed rate increase by UGI Utilities, Inc.–Gas Division for natural gas distribution service to approximately 690,000 residential, commercial, and industrial customers in 46 counties across Pennsylvania.

item.title: Fire companies, EMS agencies in Luzerne County awarded state grants
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — Fire companies and EMS agencies in Luzerne County were awarded state grants totaling more than $95,000 to support their mission of protecting public safety.

item.title: Luzerne Foundation honors longtime MMI administrator, celebrates donors at Mid-winter Gala
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — Guests gathered at the Westmoreland Club on Thursday for the Luzerne Foundation’s annual Rusty Flack Society Mid-Winter Gathering to celebrate some of the community’s most generous individuals and organizations.

item.title: Luzerne County Council to vote Tuesday on new division creation
item.description: The proposed creation of a new economic development division will be on Tuesday’s Luzerne County Council agenda for a decision.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53.

item.title: Crestwood School Board, community members discuss special education plan
item.description: Community members raised concerns and provided suggestions related to special education topics at the Crestwood School District board meeting Thursday.

item.title: Kelly O’Brien: Our technology fears repeat themselves
item.description: When mobile phones first entered the market, they were met with a mix of fascination and fear. Today, a strikingly similar pattern is unfolding around data centers, the industrial backbone of cloud computing and artificial intelligence. Although the technologies differ, the social reaction follows familiar lines: concerns about health, environmental impact, transparency, and loss of control.
